_about: The mapping walk that reached 28 of the 29 questions (runs/s2-men-explore), converted to tools/walk.js format from the commands that were actually sent. NOT a one-change test: it ticks everything. The free-text answers are short fictional medical notes, never contact details. It includes two 'Back' steps (specialist → GP, dose change No → Yes). This converted file itself has not been replayed with walk.js; if a step fails, read the screen list walk.js prints.

steps.value: Diffuse thinning on top for about 2 years. No diagnosis. Nothing makes it better or worse. No other symptoms.

label:text-is("I have a lactose intolerance or allergy")
label:text-is("I can’t tolerate any amount of lactose and I would like to be considered for non-lactose containing preparations only")

steps.value: Mild itching for 6 months. Not seen by a doctor. No treatment.
